title: NAACL: Noise-AwAre Verbal Confidence Calibration for LLMs in RAG Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and AUROC to evaluate the discrepancy between the model's verbalized confidence scores and its empirical accuracy when exposed to counterfactual, relevant, and irrelevant retrieval noise.

Evaluating model calibration and performance by embedding the ground truth passage among noise passages at various positions (1st, 2nd, or 3rd) within the context window to assess the model's sensitivity to the location of information.
